Using the Euclidean algorithm:

\[
2293 = 31\cdot 73 + 30
\]
\[
31 = 30\cdot 1 + 1
\]

So,

\[
1 = 31 - 30 = 31 - (2293 - 31\cdot 73)
\]
\[
1 = 31\cdot 74 - 2293
\]

Thus,

\[
31\cdot 74 \equiv 1 \pmod{2293}
\]

So the inverse of \(31\) modulo \(2293\) is \(74\). Therefore,

\[
n \equiv 3\cdot 74 = 222 \pmod{2293}
\]

Since \(0\leq n<2293\), we have \(n=222\).

Check:

\[
31\cdot 222 = 6882 = 3\cdot 2293 + 3
\]

So \(31\cdot 222\equiv 3\pmod{2293}\).

The answer is 222.
